techcrunch.title: PrismML hopes its tiny LLM will change how we all use AI

techcrunch.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI

techcrunch.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
techcrunch.description: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

techcrunch.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
techcrunch.description: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.

techcrunch.title: Is the AI safety debate about safety or control?
techcrunch.description: Not everyone agrees with Amodei's call for globally coordinated action for AI safety.

techcrunch.title: UN turns to Google to make its global data ready for AI agents
techcrunch.description: The shift comes after a UNICEF test found leading AI models struggled to accurately retrieve global development statistics.

techcrunch.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
techcrunch.description: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.

techcrunch.title: Waymo restarts San Antonio service 5 months after flooding troubles
techcrunch.description: The company suspended service in the city in April after one of its robotaxis got swept away.

techcrunch.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
techcrunch.description: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.

techcrunch.title: Base Labs launches an open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
techcrunch.description: Base Labs, the research group Baseten spun up earlier this year, will develop and publish methods for training and monitoring open models.

techcrunch.title: Pinterest teases a new ‘Restyle’ feature that lets you redesign your room with AI
techcrunch.description: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.

techcrunch.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Events schedule: NMI, Backblaze, PeakXV Partners, Augment, and more to host
techcrunch.description: TechCrunch Disrupt is where the tech community comes together to build, debate, and connect. And while the main event takes over Moscone West from October 13-15, the conversation doesn’t stop when the Expo Hall closes.

techcrunch.title: Apple will let EU apps use less-alarming tracking-consent screens
techcrunch.description: Apple is changing its App Tracking Transparency prompts in parts of Europe after competition regulators said the system favored Apple over third-party apps, giving developers more flexibility over how they ask users for tracking consent.

techcrunch.title: Roku’s new Labs hub brings experimental apps to the big screen
techcrunch.description: Roku’s latest OS update introduces Roku Labs, a new hub for experimental apps, alongside personalized home screens in more markets, streaming subscription bundles, and more.

techcrunch.title: Last call: Disrupt volunteer application closes soon
techcrunch.description: If you've been on the fence about volunteering at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, this is your sign to stop deliberating and start applying.

techcrunch.title: I tried Tovala’s smart oven for two weeks — here’s whether it beats takeout
techcrunch.description: Tovala offers both a smart oven and a meal-delivery service. Its meals come with QR codes that you scan using the app, allowing the oven to automatically follow the cooking instructions.

techcrunch.title: Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip as it takes on Nvidia
